hero.subtitle: My goal is to build applications that not only work well, but convey personality, elegance and a genuine experience for those who use them.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: My professional journey and technical growth.
experience.summary: Since 2024 I design, develop and ship web and mobile applications end to end, in my own projects and for real clients: frontend, backend and production, with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js and Python.
achievements: I develop a grade management system for an independent teacher working across several institutes, centralizing the registration and tracking of his students' performance.
I built and maintain Aleida Contribución, a web application with 20 to 30 active users, with role-based access control and financial reconciliation.
I reduced unnecessary re-renders by 40% with modular state architectures using Zustand (slices).
I optimized a SPA with Vite, React and TypeScript to a Lighthouse score of 97, also fixing critical navigation bugs on mobile devices.
I guarantee data integrity in production with Mongoose schemas and validations over MongoDB.
I published Renpentain, a shopping list mobile app available on Uptodown.

certificates.title: Certifications
certificates.description: Official accreditations backing my technical experience.

about.title: About
about.p1: Since I discovered programming, I fell in love with the freedom to create. I have always been fascinated by the idea of turning an idea into something real, building from scratch and bringing to life experiences that previously only existed in the imagination.
about.p2: I especially enjoy designing applications that feel organized, fluid and pleasant to use. I care about how a well-thought-out interface, animation or architecture can make technology stop feeling cold and become a natural extension of people.
about.p3: I am a Full Stack developer focused on JavaScript and TypeScript (React, Next.js, Node.js), expanding my stack towards Python with FastAPI. I design and ship web and mobile applications end to end: architecture, backend, frontend and production.
about.p4: I am passionate about constantly learning, solving complex problems and improving every detail of the projects I build, both technically and visually.
